The only transport fault is loss of two first-context heartbeats, which is permitted by the transport send-failure paths; delivered messages are FIFO. In one synchronous history, prefix event 0 names origin 2 and actual follower readiness, admission event 4 reads its actual pending readStatus context 101/30, and event 14 reads actual GetUpdate.ReadyToReads context 202/30 before Commit clears it. The response at event 13 was produced by the real confirmation handler after actual heartbeat acknowledgments. Identity is scenario plus origin; exactly one operation is issued per origin, and context is only the compared value. The control origin 3 independently associates prefix 1, admission 10 and result 16, retaining 202/30. These match the recorded monitor correlations, with no parse loss or missing results. Term and membership remain stable by the fixed driver and endpoint observations. This establishes the local context-substitution defect; the test process passing is not the basis of the verdict.
